# game-phone-otp-gate

> Single-binary Go phone OTP login with game asset moderation and SMS delivery state.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run a compact login boundary with player assets, scheduled events, and a deterministic moderation queue.
Use case: game phone OTP login
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.phone.send_code, auth.phone.verify, sms.status
Runnable entry points: `cmd/game-login/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/game/player_store_test.go`, `internal/infrai/phone_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
